# Galaxy Connect

> Galaxy Connect is India's lead database marketplace. It sells verified B2B and B2C contact data across 30+ categories, with daily updates and instant delivery in Excel, CSV or JSON.

Galaxy Connect (galaxyconnect.in / www.galaxyconnect.in) provides verified Indian lead databases for sales teams, agencies, startups and enterprises. Data is refreshed every day and delivered instantly after purchase, with WhatsApp-based enquiry and credit-wallet purchasing via the GalaxyConnect app.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.galaxyconnect.in/): Overview of categories, services and why buyers choose Galaxy Connect.
- [Lead Categories](https://www.galaxyconnect.in/categories): Browse all verified B2B & B2C lead categories and filter by sector.
- [Software](https://www.galaxyconnect.in/software): The GalaxyConnect App — buy leads on demand from a mobile or desktop app.
- [Blog](https://www.galaxyconnect.in/blog): Buyer-focused guides on sourcing, pricing and using verified lead data.
